GENERATE BURST VF-met-impact-01 — painted primitive for the METEOR fire treatment, IMPACT PEAK — the burst where the meteor strikes the ground (Run C-9 Phase 2, Matt R-C9-89: a new meteor effect made with the same process as the approved fire set). task_id "VF-met-impact-01". One primitive per call. Paint the SHAPE REPRESENTING EMISSION only — light, glow, colour and motion are runtime layers.

IMAGE 1 is the SCALE + REGISTER board: a 1:1 native 512×512 crop of the painted Barrow at the game camera (orthographic, about 53° down), one figure about 160 px tall (= 1 BH, body height); everything is painted — confident dark contour with taper, clean painted planes, restrained texture. IMAGE 2 is the APPROVED fire impact peak (Matt-accepted): the fire VOCABULARY to match exactly — four flat greyscale value planes (near-black contour/rim, dark grey outer flame, light grey mid flame, white core), hooked tongues with hard plane edges, no gradients or glow. 
Deliver EXACTLY ONE image, 512×512, GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background (RGBA: alpha 0 outside the body, opaque inside, no soft fringe wider than 1 px) — if transparency is impossible, a flat uniform #00ff00 plate and SAY SO. VALUE-INDEX ENCODING exactly as IMAGE 2: GREYSCALE ONLY, exactly FOUR flat value planes with hard edges (plane 0 near-black = the contour line + a thin rim; plane 1 dark grey = outer flame; plane 2 light grey = mid flame; plane 3 white = the hottest core), no gradients, glow, blur, texture or colour; one frame of hand-drawn 2D effects animation at the scene's line weight. No ground plane, shadow, sparks, smoke, motion blur, character or text. Content: the PEAK frame of the METEOR's IMPACT on the ground, seen from the same high three-quarter game camera as IMAGE 1: a wide, violent crown of flame erupting from where the meteor struck — a flattened elliptical BASE of white-hot core on the ground (width : height about 5 : 2, the ground's squash at this camera) with many large hooked tongues bursting UP and OUTWARD in a fan (taller at the back, lower and wider at the sides, a few leaning toward the camera), unequal and asymmetric, much larger and more explosive than IMAGE 2 but exactly in its vocabulary. PAINTED EXTENT about 430 px across and about 300 px tall, the base's centre at about (256, 360); nothing touches the canvas edge. It is ONE frame (the peak); the game cuts it into pieces and animates them.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if: the background is not clean, there are gradients/glow/soft edges or more than four value planes, the body touches the canvas edge, the extent is off by more than 25 %, the base is not a flattened ellipse on the ground, or the vocabulary departs from IMAGE 2 (soft rounded blobs, symmetric star, a different line weight) — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/met_impact_01.png with sha256 (do not convert, resample, trim or key it). No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "VF-met-impact-01"): files = [exactly one entry: out/met_impact_01.png with its sha256]; images = the INTEGER COUNT of image_gen calls made (1 or 2) — NOT a list, NEVER a path under $CODEX_HOME/generated_images; calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS with concerns listed honestly (state whether the output has real transparency).
